title: Dialog
purpose: Interrupt the current context only when a focused task or decision requires temporary modal attention.

composition.role: opens the dialog and usually receives focus back

composition.semantics: heading referenced by aria-labelledby or native equivalent

composition.role: information or task that justifies interruption

composition.semantics: buttons, form controls or links as appropriate

initial_focus.rule: Choose based on task and content; do not default blindly to the first focusable element.

strategies.information_long_content: focus a static heading or content start with tabindex=-1
strategies.simple_acknowledgement: focus the most likely continue/OK action when appropriate

closing.backdrop_click: must be explicitly decided; default false
closing.focus_return: return to invoker when it still exists unless workflow requires another logical target
closing.preferred_cancel_api: HTMLDialogElement.requestClose() when available; fall back to close() for older targets.

light_dismiss.rule: Backdrop/light-dismiss is an explicit product decision, never inferred.
light_dismiss.platform_note: closedby="any" can express light dismiss declaratively where supported, but closedby is not yet a Baseline requirement.

stacking.multiple_modals: avoid unless necessary; Escape closes only the topmost modal

invoker_commands.rule: May replace JavaScript wiring where target-browser support is acceptable; must not change the focus and workflow contract.

layout.default: centered modal surface in top layer
layout.narrow_viewport: may become edge-to-edge or nearly full-screen while preserving task structure
layout.max_height: content may scroll inside the dialog rather than forcing viewport overflow

visual.preserve: clear modal boundary, strong heading/action hierarchy and visible focus

accessibility.dialog_tabindex: Do not put tabindex on the dialog element itself; focus a suitable descendant or static content node.
accessibility.description_strategy: Use aria-describedby for short/simple descriptive text when useful. Omit it for long or semantically structured content that should be read in its own structure.

constraints: Do not use a modal dialog when interaction outside must remain available.
Do not mark a surface modal unless outside content is actually inert.
Do not remove Escape dismissal without a compelling, explicit requirement.
Do not rely on Escape or backdrop click as the only way to close.
Do not choose initial focus solely by DOM order.
Do not move focus to a destructive action by default when the action is hard to reverse.
Do not implement a custom focus trap when native dialog behavior already satisfies the contract.
Do not allow background interaction while a modal dialog is open.
Do not require closedby or Invoker Commands API support unless the target browser matrix explicitly allows it.
Do not apply aria-describedby to long or semantically structured dialog content merely to force one large announcement.

agent_contract.instruction: Reconstruct from this Build DNA rather than copying reference HTML. Use native dialog behavior when the target platform supports it. Ask for missing modal, close, focus and workflow decisions instead of inventing them.
agent_contract.when_conflicting: Purpose, constraints, behavior and accessibility override visual resemblance.
agent_contract.output_expectation: Production-appropriate dialog code for the requested stack plus explicitly listed unresolved interaction decisions.

request_examples.prompt: Baue mir einen Dialog nach https://blame76.github.io/how-to-web/elements/interactive/dialog/ und nutze die Build DNA als Rekonstruktionsvertrag.
Baue mir die Variante "Information / Long Content". Setze den Initialfokus auf einen statischen Startpunkt, damit der Inhalt von Anfang an verständlich gelesen werden kann.
Baue mir die Variante "Form". Setze den Initialfokus auf das erste für den Task relevante Eingabefeld.
Baue mir die Variante "Destructive Confirmation". Setze den Initialfokus auf die weniger destruktive Aktion und bewahre Escape/Cancel.

request_examples.intent: Adapt the Dialog contract to an existing stack.
request_examples.prompt: Übertrage den how-to-web Dialog in mein bestehendes Projekt. Nutze vorhandene Tokens und Komponenten und bewahre Modalität, Fokus, Escape und Focus Return.

acceptance: The dialog has an accessible name.
Opening the modal makes background content non-interactive.
Initial focus matches the documented task-specific strategy.
Tab and Shift+Tab remain within the modal dialog.
Escape closes the topmost modal dialog.
A visible explicit close or cancel action exists.
Closing returns focus to the invoker unless another logical workflow target is documented.
A destructive confirmation does not initially focus the destructive action.
The dialog remains usable at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom.
No unintended horizontal page overflow occurs while the dialog is open.

examples.note: Long structured information with initial focus on a static heading.
Task form with initial focus on the first relevant input.
Destructive confirmation with initial focus on Cancel.
